note: Each claim binds a sentence in a component card to a test of the built system. `quote` must still appear in `card` verbatim: edit the card and the claim fails until it is updated with it, so the prose and the code cannot drift apart silently. `test` is evaluated in the loaded preview and returns true, or a string saying what it found.

claims.quote: **Three per row on desktop, one below 768px.**
claims.expect: the service grid is a single column
claims.test: const n = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.grid')).gridTemplateColumns.split(' ').length; return n === 1 || `${n} columns`;

claims.quote: **Three per row on desktop, one below 768px.**
claims.expect: three per row on desktop
claims.test: const n = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.grid')).gridTemplateColumns.split(' ').length; return n === 3 || `${n} columns`;

claims.quote: **From 900px up the back button gives way to the side rail**
claims.expect: .mt-shell__back is not displayed
claims.test: const e = document.querySelector('.mt-shell__back'); if (!e) return 'no back control in the preview'; const d = getComputedStyle(e).display; return d === 'none' || `display: ${d}`;

claims.quote: **From 900px up the back button gives way to the side rail**
claims.expect: below 900px the back control is there
claims.test: const e = document.querySelector('.mt-shell__back'); if (!e) return 'no back control in the preview'; const d = getComputedStyle(e).display; return d !== 'none' || 'hidden below 900px too';

claims.quote: Freeze the header with `shadow-sm` once the body scrolls.
claims.expect: the header cell is sticky and carries a shadow
claims.test: const cs = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.mt-table th')); if (cs.position !== 'sticky') return `position: ${cs.position}`; return /rgb/.test(cs.boxShadow) || `box-shadow: ${cs.boxShadow}`;

claims.quote: The preview beside this card carries both.
claims.expect: the canonical table has mt-table--stack and every cell a data-label
claims.test: const t = document.querySelector('.mt-table'); if (!t.classList.contains('mt-table--stack')) return 'no mt-table--stack'; const bare = [...t.querySelectorAll('tbody td')].filter(td => !td.hasAttribute('data-label')); return bare.length === 0 || `${bare.length} cells without data-label`;

claims.quote: `mt-hero__aside` is `display: none` there
claims.expect: the hero aside is not rendered on a phone
claims.test: const e = document.querySelector('.mt-hero__aside'); if (!e) return true; const d = getComputedStyle(e).display; return d === 'none' || `display: ${d}`;

claims.quote: Padding is `space-5`, dropping to `space-4` below 768px.
claims.expect: card padding is 16px below 768px
claims.test: const p = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.mt-card')).paddingTop; return p === '16px' || p;

claims.quote: **Every number is a `tel:` link**
claims.expect: every telephone number sits inside a tel: anchor
claims.test: const tel = [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="tel:"]')]; const inside = new Set(tel.map(a => a.textContent.replace(/\D/g,''))); const loose = []; document.querySelectorAll('.mt-office__line').forEach(li => { const txt = li.textContent; const m = txt.match(/\+\d[\d\s]{6,}/g) || []; m.forEach(x => { const d = x.replace(/\D/g,''); if (![...inside].some(i => i.includes(d) || d.includes(i))) loose.push(x.trim()); }); }); return loose.length === 0 || `not dialable: ${loose.join(', ')}`;

claims.quote: **never drop the role**
claims.expect: every identity block carries the role line
claims.test: const ids = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-assistant__id')]; if (!ids.length) return 'no identity block in the preview'; const bad = ids.filter(i => !i.querySelector('.mt-assistant__role')); return bad.length === 0 || `${bad.length} identity block(s) without a role`;

claims.quote: **Every notification names its record.**
claims.expect: every notification carries a reference
claims.test: const n = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-note')]; if (!n.length) return 'no notifications in the preview'; const bad = n.filter(x => !x.querySelector('.mt-note__ref')); return bad.length === 0 || `${bad.length} notification(s) without a reference`;

claims.quote: **Every bar is directly labelled with its value.**
claims.expect: every bar row shows its value
claims.test: const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-figure__row')]; if (!r.length) return 'no figure rows in the preview'; const bad = r.filter(x => !x.querySelector('.mt-figure__value')); return bad.length === 0 || `${bad.length} bar(s) without a value`;

claims.quote: Every FAQ block ships a matching `FAQPage` JSON-LD with one `Question` per item, the answer text identical to what is rendered.
claims.expect: a FAQPage block whose questions match the rendered ones
claims.test: const s = document.querySelector('script[type="application/ld+json"]'); if (!s) return 'no JSON-LD in the preview'; let d; try { d = JSON.parse(s.textContent); } catch (e) { return 'JSON-LD does not parse'; } if (d['@type'] !== 'FAQPage') return `@type is ${d['@type']}`; const asked = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-faq__q span:first-child')].map(x => x.textContent.trim()); const marked = (d.mainEntity || []).map(q => q.name.trim()); const missing = asked.filter(q => !marked.includes(q)); return missing.length === 0 || `not marked up: ${missing.join(' | ')}`;

claims.quote: Never open all of them
claims.expect: opening every question in turn cannot leave them all open
claims.test: const qs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-faq__q')]; qs.forEach(q => q.click()); const open = qs.filter(q => q.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true').length; return open < qs.length || `all ${qs.length} are open`;

claims.quote: colour
claims.expect: every badge carries a word, not only a colour
claims.test: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-badge')]; if (!b.length) return 'no badges in the preview'; const bad = b.filter(x => !x.textContent.trim()); return bad.length === 0 || `${bad.length} badge(s) with no text`;

claims.quote: Never `0`, never `—`.
claims.expect: no cell stands in for a figure with a dash (the statement has the most empty cells)
claims.test: const bad = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-doc__table td')].filter(td => /^[—–-]$/.test(td.textContent.trim())); return bad.length === 0 || `${bad.length} cell(s) hold only a dash`;

claims.quote: lane
claims.expect: trade lanes stack to one column on a phone
claims.test: const g = document.querySelector('.g2'); if (!g) return true; const n = getComputedStyle(g).gridTemplateColumns.split(' ').length; return n === 1 || `${n} columns`;

claims.quote: No amount appears here.
claims.expect: no currency and no money column anywhere in the document
claims.test: const money = document.querySelectorAll('.mt-doc__money').length; if (money) return `${money} money cell(s)`; const cur = /\b(USD|EUR|AED|SYP)\b/.test(document.querySelector('.mt-doc').textContent); return !cur || 'a currency code appears in the text';

claims.quote: The status column is a StatusBadge per row
claims.expect: every line carries its own status badge
claims.test: const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-doc__table tbody tr')]; if (!rows.length) return 'no lines'; const bad = rows.filter(r => !r.querySelector('.mt-badge')); return bad.length === 0 || `${bad.length} line(s) without a status`;

claims.quote: **The driver signs for the count and the condition of the packages, not for their contents.**
claims.expect: the document says what the signature does not cover
claims.test: const t = document.querySelector('.mt-doc').textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' '); return /signs for the count and the condition of the packages, not for their contents/.test(t) || 'the sentence is not on the document';

claims.quote: a statement covers a span, not a date
claims.expect: the meta rows name a period
claims.test: const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-doc__meta-row')].map(r => r.firstElementChild.textContent.trim()); return rows.includes('Period') || `meta rows are ${rows.join(', ')}`;

claims.quote: Each row shows the balance **after** that movement
claims.expect: every movement carries a balance
claims.test: const heads = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-doc__table thead th')].map(h => h.textContent.trim()); const i = heads.indexOf('Balance'); if (i < 0) return `no Balance column (${heads.join(', ')})`; const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-doc__table tbody tr')]; const bad = rows.filter(r => !(r.children[i] && r.children[i].textContent.trim())); return bad.length === 0 || `${bad.length} movement(s) without a balance`;

claims.quote: **no border and no fill**
claims.expect: mt-avatar has no border, no painted background, and is centred - the mark is already a disc
claims.test: const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-avatar')]; if (!a.length) return 'no avatar in the preview'; const bad = []; for (const el of a) { const cs = getComputedStyle(el); const bw = ['Top','Right','Bottom','Left'].map(s => parseFloat(cs['border'+s+'Width'])||0); if (bw.some(w => w > 0)) bad.push('border '+bw.join('/')); const bg = cs.backgroundColor.replace(/\s/g,''); if (!(bg === 'rgba(0,0,0,0)' || bg === 'transparent')) bad.push('background '+cs.backgroundColor); const op = cs.objectPosition.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); if (!(op === '50% 50%' || op === 'center' || op === 'center center')) bad.push('object-position '+op); } return bad.length === 0 || bad.join('; ');
